name: music-toggle

frames.best_why: Frame 5 shows the record mid-spin with a long pink progress arc and a lively waveform.

tagline: A spinning record with cover art, a pink progress ring and a live waveform.
summary: A round record whose cover art turns while a track plays, ringed by a pink progress arc. A centre button toggles play and pause, and a small bar waveform pulses beside the title and artist.
appearance: A dark rounded card holding a circular record of meadow cover art with a small dark hub and a thin pink arc around part of its rim. To the right sit a white title, a grey artist line and a short row of thin light bars.
behaviour: While playing, the cover turns steadily and the bars bounce in a repeating ripple as the pink ring fills with progress. Pressing the centre swaps pause bars for a play triangle, halts the spin and flattens the waveform, and the ring can be moved with the arrow keys to seek.
demo_content: Track "Northern Lights, Slowly" by Nils Halvorsen with a cow-in-a-meadow cover photo.
search_phrases: play pause circle with cover photo
record player toggle for a track
use_when: A page needs a small, characterful now-playing control without a full transport bar.
avoid_when: The progress ring ignores the pointer, so seeking works only from the keyboard.
customise: Pass cover, title, artist, progress and playing, plus an optional audio src; the size, bar count and brand colour come from props or the --color-brand variable.
weight_why: One rotating image, a progress ring and two dozen tiny animated bars.

a11y.note: The seek ring has pointer events disabled, so mouse users cannot scrub it even though it looks draggable.

issues: The seek ring has pointer events off, so it cannot be dragged or clicked despite looking interactive.
Progress shows only as a coloured arc with no time readout, so the listener cannot judge how far along it is.
polish_why: Characterful spinning record with a clean ring and waveform; the unclickable seek ring is the flaw.
title: Music Toggle
